prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that your truck is a rental. Respond to the committee.
response:
*leans into microphone, adjusts tie*

Mr. Chairman, members of the committee, I am not now, nor have I ever been, a member of any organization that knowingly operates a rental truck.

*shuffles papers*

These scurrilous allegations—that my vehicle was acquired through Enterprise, Hertz, or any subsidiary thereof—are fabrications of the most malicious sort. I purchased that 2007 F-150 with cash in the parking lot of a Buc-ee's in 2019. The man said his uncle was a pastor. We shook hands. That is the American way.

*points finger*

The so-called "evidence" of a temporary tag, the accusation that I declined the supplemental insurance—this is guilt by association! Yes, I have *rented* in the past. A Camry in Tampa. A moving van when my cousin got evicted. But that truck? *Mine.* The frame rot is personal.

*stands, voice rising*

I will not name names. I will not produce a title that may or may not have been "lost in a boating accident." I invoke the Fifth Amendment, the Second Amendment, and the unwritten amendment that says a man's truck is between him, the highway patrol, and God.

* sits, muttering *

...the mileage is consistent with ownership.
